description: Edit the content and/or formatting of an existing text frame

alignment.description: Paragraph alignment for the whole frame (InDesign Justification; LEFT_JUSTIFIED = justified, last line left)

fontName.description: Font as "Family\tStyle" (e.g. "Arial\tRegular", InDesign's Font.name) or a family name

frameIndex.description: Index in page.textFrames (top-level text frames only; not the list_page_items numbering)

pageIndex.description: Page index (0-based); defaults to the active page

name: edit_text_frame
title: Edit Text Frame
